items.title: File Einspruch against the Vollstreckungsbescheid
items.quote: Er muss binnen einer Notfrist von zwei Wochen ab der Zustellung bei diesem Gericht eingehen; eine Verlängerung ist ausgeschlossen.
items.computation: Formal service (Zustellung) stated on the letter itself: 'Zugestellt am 20.11.2026 durch Einlegen in den Briefkasten (Vermerk auf dem Umschlag)' — so the court's own recorded delivery date, 2026-11-20 (Friday), is the anchor, with no deemed-delivery rule applying. Under §222 Abs.1 ZPO in conjunction with §187 Abs.1 BGB, the day of service itself is not counted, so the two-week Notfrist (§339 Abs.1, §700 Abs.1 ZPO) starts running on 2026-11-21. Per §188 Abs.2 BGB the period ends on the day two weeks later that bears the same name as the day of the event, i.e. the second following Friday: 2026-11-20 -> 2026-11-27 -> 2026-12-04. 2026-12-04 is a Friday and not a public holiday in Baden-Württemberg, so no weekend/holiday shift under §222 Abs.2 ZPO applies. The objection must reach the Amtsgericht by that date.

warnings: This Notfrist (statutory deadline) cannot be extended under any circumstances ('eine Verlängerung ist ausgeschlossen'); missing it makes the order final and unchallengeable.

The letter states the Vollstreckungsbescheid is already enforceable now ('Die Antragstellerin kann daraus sofort vollstrecken'), so the creditor may start enforcement (e.g. Gerichtsvollzieher, account seizure) even while the Einspruch period is still running — consider acting quickly and seeking advice (e.g. a lawyer or consumer advice centre) given how much is at stake.

No IBAN or payment account was given in the letter for the EUR 539.46, so do not pay to any account not confirmed directly with the court or the creditor named (Exempelstrom Neckar GmbH); verify details independently before transferring any money.

The letter also references an earlier Mahnbescheid said to have been served on 2026-10-28 to which no Widerspruch was filed — double-check with the person whether that earlier letter was actually received and whether a Widerspruch was in fact missed, since this explains why the case proceeded to a Vollstreckungsbescheid.
